author: Warner Bros.
description: The New Yorker says Paul Thomas Anderson’s “’One Battle After Another” doesn’t simply meet the moment…it forges a moment all its own, and insists that better ones could still lie ahead.” Nominated for 13 Academy Awards and 14 BAFTA Awards including Best Picture. Now playing in theaters.
title: One Battle After Another | "It's One for the Ages, Wild and Thrilling"
